overview.en: Adult integumentary content: skin anatomy and risk factors, wound healing, diagnostic tests, fungal/viral/bacterial skin infections (Candida, herpes zoster, MRSA, cellulitis), contact dermatitis, bites and stings, frostbite, skin cancer, psoriasis, acne, Stevens-Johnson syndrome and pressure injury.
overview.zh: 成人皮膚系統：皮膚解剖與危險因子、傷口癒合、診斷檢查、真菌/病毒/細菌性皮膚感染（念珠菌、帶狀疱疹、MRSA、蜂窩性組織炎）、接觸性皮膚炎、咬傷與螫傷、凍傷、皮膚癌、乾癬、痤瘡、史蒂文斯-強生症候群與壓力性損傷。

heading.en: Skin anatomy, risks and psychosocial impact
heading.zh: 皮膚解剖、危險因子與心理社會影響

points.en: Skin is the largest organ: barrier against infection, sensation, thermoregulation, excretion, prevents water loss, vitamin D synthesis, nutrient storage.
points.zh: 皮膚是最大器官：感染屏障、感覺、體溫調節、排泄、防止水分流失、合成維生素D、儲存養分。

points.en: Layers: epidermis, dermis, hypodermis; appendages: nails, hair, sebaceous and sweat glands; acidic pH 4.2-5.6 limits bacterial growth.
points.zh: 層次：表皮、真皮、皮下組織；附屬物：指甲、毛髮、皮脂腺與汗腺；pH 4.2-5.6的酸性環境抑制細菌。

points.en: Risks: sun/tanning, radiation, pollutants, poor hygiene, harsh soaps, long-term glucocorticoids, nutritional deficiency, stress, infection, repeated injury, genetics, systemic illness.
points.zh: 危險因子：日曬/日光浴、輻射、污染物、衛生不良、強效肥皂、長期糖皮質激素、營養不良、壓力、感染、反覆損傷、遺傳、全身性疾病。

points.en: Psychosocial effects: body-image change, low self-esteem, social isolation, pain, activity limits, cost.
points.zh: 心理社會影響：身體心像改變、自尊低落、社交孤立、疼痛、活動受限、費用負擔。

points.en: Inflammatory phase 3-5 days (edema, pain, redness, warmth); fibroblastic from day 4 for 2-4 weeks (granulation tissue, scar); maturation from ~3 weeks up to 1 year.
points.zh: 發炎期3-5天（水腫、疼痛、紅、熱）；纖維母細胞期自第4天起2-4週（肉芽組織、疤痕）；成熟期約3週起可達1年。

points.en: First intention: edges approximated (sutures). Second: tissue loss fills in gradually. Third: delayed primary closure after being left open for cleaning.
points.zh: 第一癒合：傷口緣對合（縫合）。第二癒合：組織缺損逐漸填補。第三癒合：先敞開清創後延遲縫合。

points.en: Drainage: serous (clear) and serosanguineous (pink) normal; sanguineous and hemorrhagic abnormal; purulent (yellow/gray/green) means infection.
points.zh: 引流液：漿液性（清澈）與漿液血性（粉紅）屬正常；血性與出血為異常；膿性（黃/灰/綠）表示感染。

points.en: Skin biopsy (punch, excisional, shave): confirm consent, send specimen to pathology; keep dressing on at least 8 h; sutures out in 7-10 days; report drainage, redness.
points.zh: 皮膚切片（打孔、切除、削切）：確認同意書、送病理；敷料至少保留8小時；7-10天拆線；通報滲液、紅腫。

points.en: Skin/wound culture: obtain before antibiotics; viral cultures go on ice; nasal swab screens exposure.
points.zh: 皮膚/傷口培養：於抗生素前採檢；病毒培養置冰上；鼻腔拭子篩檢帶菌。

points.en: Wood's light (UV) identifies superficial infections: darken room, reassure that light is harmless, help adjust afterward.
points.zh: 伍氏燈（紫外線）辨識表淺感染：暗室、說明無害、事後協助適應光線。

points.en: Diascopy: press glass slide on lesion to blanch erythema.
points.zh: 玻片壓診：以玻片壓迫病灶使紅斑褪色以便觀察。

points.en: Candida: superficial yeast infection (skinfolds, perineum, axilla, mouth thrush); risk: immunosuppression, long antibiotics, diabetes, obesity; keep folds clean/dry, mouth care, antifungals.
points.zh: 念珠菌：表淺酵母感染（皮膚皺褶、會陰、腋下、口腔鵝口瘡）；危險因子：免疫抑制、長期抗生素、糖尿病、肥胖；保持皺褶乾燥、口腔護理、抗黴菌藥。

points.en: Shingles: reactivated varicella-zoster in dorsal root ganglia; unilateral segmental vesicles with burning pain; Tzanck smear/viral culture; postherpetic neuralgia possible.
points.zh: 帶狀疱疹：水痘帶狀疱疹病毒於背根神經節再活化；單側節段性水泡伴灼痛；Tzanck抹片/病毒培養；可能有疱疹後神經痛。

points.en: Shingles care: contact precautions while vesicles present; cool environment, air mattress/bed cradle, loose cotton clothes, astringent compresses; antivirals within 3 days; vaccine at age 50+.
points.zh: 帶狀疱疹照護：水泡期接觸防護；環境涼爽、氣墊床/床架；寬鬆棉質衣物；收斂濕敷；3天內抗病毒藥；50歲以上接種疫苗。

points.en: Staff who never had chickenpox or varicella vaccine should not care for shingles clients; watch for Bell's palsy.
points.zh: 未得過水痘或未接種水痘疫苗的工作人員不應照護帶狀疱疹病人；注意貝爾氏麻痺。

points.en: MRSA: folliculitis, furuncles; confirm with culture and sensitivity; standard + contact precautions, antibiotics, monitor for sepsis.
points.zh: MRSA：毛囊炎、癤；以培養與藥敏確認；標準+接觸防護、抗生素、監測敗血症。

heading.zh: 蜂窩性組織炎、丹毒與植物性皮膚炎

points.en: Erysipelas: acute superficial infection of upper skin layers (group A Strep). Cellulitis: dermis and hypodermis (Strep or S. aureus).
points.zh: 丹毒：表層皮膚急性感染（A群鏈球菌）。蜂窩性組織炎：真皮與皮下組織（鏈球菌或金黃色葡萄球菌）。

points.en: Signs: pain, erythema, warmth, edema, fever; rest affected area, warm compresses, culture before antibiotics.
points.zh: 徵象：疼痛、紅、熱、水腫、發燒；患部休息、溫敷、抗生素前先採培養。

points.en: Poison ivy/oak/sumac: urushiol causes papulovesicular itchy dermatitis; wash skin immediately (lather and rinse repeatedly), cool compresses, topical or oral steroids if severe.
points.zh: 毒藤/毒橡樹/毒漆樹：urushiol引起丘疹水泡性癢疹；立即清洗皮膚（反覆起泡沖洗）、冷濕敷、嚴重者用外用或口服類固醇。

points.en: Brown recluse: necrotic wound; ice early and intermittently up to 4 days. Black widow: neurotoxin; ice immediately. Tarantula: remove barbed hairs with sticky tape, irrigate eyes, elevate. Keep tetanus current; call Poison Control.
points.zh: 棕色隱士蛛：壞死性傷口；早期間歇冰敷可達4天。黑寡婦蛛：神經毒；立即冰敷。狼蛛：用膠帶黏除倒刺毛、沖洗眼睛、抬高。維持破傷風疫苗；聯絡毒物中心。

points.en: Bark scorpion: neurotoxic, dangerous in children/elderly; go to ED, antivenom.
points.zh: 樹皮蠍：神經毒，對兒童與老人危險；立即就醫，使用抗蛇毒血清。

points.en: Bee/wasp: scrape stinger off (no tweezers), ice; anaphylaxis needs epinephrine autoinjector IM, then ED; carry two injectors; watch for rebound anaphylaxis.
points.zh: 蜜蜂/黃蜂：刮除螫針（勿用鑷子）、冰敷；過敏性休克用腎上腺素自動注射筆肌注後送急診；攜帶兩支；注意二次反應。

points.en: Snakebite: first move victim away and keep at rest, remove jewelry/constrictions, immobilize limb below heart, keep warm, no caffeine/alcohol, no cutting/sucking/ice, get to hospital for antivenom.
points.zh: 蛇咬：先將傷者移離現場並休息、取下首飾/束縛物、肢體固定並低於心臟、保暖、不給咖啡因/酒精、不切開/吸毒/冰敷、儘速就醫給抗蛇毒血清。

points.en: Frostbite stages: 1st white plaque with hyperemia; 2nd clear blisters; 3rd hemorrhagic blisters/eschar; 4th full-thickness necrosis into muscle/bone.
points.zh: 凍傷分級：1度白斑與周圍充血；2度透明水泡；3度出血性水泡/焦痂；4度全層壞死達肌肉/骨。

points.en: Frostbite care: rewarm rapidly in 40-42 C (104-107.6 F) water, handle gently, no rubbing or dry heat, analgesics, loose dressings, tetanus, monitor compartment syndrome.
points.zh: 凍傷處理：以40-42 C（104-107.6 F）溫水快速復溫、動作輕柔、不可搓揉或乾熱、止痛、鬆散敷料、破傷風、監測骨筋膜室症候群。

heading.zh: 光化性角化症與皮膚癌

points.en: Actinic keratosis: rough scaly premalignant lesion from sun exposure, may progress to squamous cell carcinoma.
points.zh: 光化性角化症：日曬造成的粗糙鱗屑性癌前病灶，可進展為鱗狀細胞癌。

points.en: Basal cell: pearly papule with central crater and waxy border, rarely metastasizes. Squamous cell: oozing, crusting lesion, can metastasize. Melanoma: irregular, multicolored, highly metastatic.
points.zh: 基底細胞癌：珍珠狀丘疹、中央凹陷、蠟質邊緣，少轉移。鱗狀細胞癌：滲液結痂病灶，可轉移。黑色素瘤：不規則多色、高度轉移。

points.en: Risks: sun, tanning beds, light skin, age >60, outdoor work, radiation, chemicals; skin biopsy confirms.
points.zh: 危險因子：日曬、日光浴床、淺膚色、>60歲、戶外工作、輻射、化學物質；以皮膚切片確診。

points.en: Teach monthly self-exam, sunscreen reapplication, protective clothing, avoid sun 10 a.m.-4 p.m.; treatment includes cryosurgery, curettage/electrodesiccation, excision.
points.zh: 教導每月自我檢查、防曬乳補擦、防護衣物、避開上午10點至下午4點日曬；治療含冷凍、刮除電燒、切除。

heading.zh: 乾癬、痤瘡、史蒂文斯-強生症候群、壓力性損傷

points.en: Psoriasis: chronic non-infectious, raised red plaques with silvery-white scales on scalp, knees, elbows, sacrum; nail pitting; Koebner phenomenon; psoriatic arthritis; improvement = fewer, thinner plaques and scales.
points.zh: 乾癬：慢性非感染性，頭皮、膝、肘、薦部紅色隆起斑塊覆銀白色鱗屑；指甲點狀凹陷；Koebner現象；乾癬性關節炎；改善＝斑塊變少變薄、鱗屑減少。

points.en: Psoriasis teaching: don't scratch, keep skin lubricated, cotton clothing, avoid OTC drugs, stress reduction, watch for infection.
points.zh: 乾癬衛教：勿抓、保持潤膚、棉質衣物、避免自行用成藥、減壓、注意感染。

points.en: Acne: comedones, papules, pustules, nodules; don't scrub or squeeze, use noncomedogenic water-based products, follow-up.
points.zh: 痤瘡：粉刺、丘疹、膿皰、結節；勿用力搓洗或擠壓、使用不致粉刺的水性產品、定期追蹤。

points.en: Stevens-Johnson/TEN: drug-induced (sulfonamides, antiseizure drugs, NSAIDs); flu-like prodrome, mucosal/skin erythema, blisters; can involve eyes, airway; stop the causative drug immediately, supportive care.
points.zh: 史蒂文斯-強生症候群/TEN：藥物誘發（磺胺類、抗癲癇藥、NSAIDs）；類流感前驅症狀、黏膜/皮膚紅斑水泡；可侵犯眼睛、呼吸道；立即停用致病藥物並支持性照護。

points.en: Stage 2 pressure injury: partial-thickness dermal loss, shallow open ulcer or blister; stage 1 intact, stage 3 full-thickness, stage 4 exposed bone/tendon/muscle.
points.zh: 第2期壓力性損傷：真皮部分皮層缺損、淺開放潰瘍或水泡；第1期皮膚完整、第3期全層、第4期暴露骨/肌腱/肌肉。

critical_points.en: Obtain skin/wound cultures before starting antibiotics.
critical_points.zh: 於抗生素前採集皮膚/傷口培養。

critical_points.en: Normal wound drainage is serous or serosanguineous; purulent drainage signals infection.
critical_points.zh: 正常引流為漿液性或漿液血性；膿性代表感染。

critical_points.en: Shingles: contact precautions while vesicles present; staff never infected or vaccinated for varicella must not be assigned.
critical_points.zh: 帶狀疱疹：水泡期接觸防護；未得過或未接種水痘疫苗的工作人員不可指派。

critical_points.en: Antivirals started within 3 days of shingles rash reduce pain and postherpetic neuralgia.
critical_points.zh: 帶狀疱疹出疹3天內開始抗病毒藥可減輕疼痛與疱疹後神經痛。

critical_points.en: Cellulitis involves dermis/hypodermis; erysipelas is superficial.
critical_points.zh: 蜂窩性組織炎侵犯真皮/皮下；丹毒為表淺。

critical_points.en: Poison ivy exposure: wash skin immediately and repeatedly; calamine only if dermatitis develops.
critical_points.zh: 接觸毒藤：立即反覆清洗皮膚；出現皮膚炎才用calamine。

critical_points.en: Snakebite first priority: move victim away from snake, rest; then remove jewelry, immobilize limb below heart; no ice, cutting or suction.
critical_points.zh: 蛇咬首要：將傷者移離蛇並休息；之後取下首飾、固定肢體低於心臟；不冰敷、不切開、不吸毒。

critical_points.en: Bee stinger: scrape off, no tweezers; anaphylaxis: IM epinephrine then ED; carry two autoinjectors.
critical_points.zh: 蜜蜂螫針：刮除、勿用鑷子；過敏性休克：肌注腎上腺素再送急診；攜帶兩支注射筆。

critical_points.en: Brown recluse/black widow bites: apply ice; keep tetanus current; call Poison Control.
critical_points.zh: 棕隱士蛛/黑寡婦蛛咬傷：冰敷；維持破傷風疫苗；聯絡毒物中心。

critical_points.en: Frostbite: rewarm in 104-107.6 F (40-42 C) water; never rub or use dry heat; white/blue, hard, numb skin.
critical_points.zh: 凍傷：104-107.6 F（40-42 C）溫水復溫；禁搓揉與乾熱；皮膚白/藍、硬、麻木。

critical_points.en: Melanoma: changing mole (color/border), highly metastatic, painless; basal cell: pearly papule, central crater, rarely metastasizes.
critical_points.zh: 黑色素瘤：痣的顏色/邊緣改變、高度轉移、無痛；基底細胞癌：珍珠狀丘疹、中央凹陷、少轉移。

critical_points.en: Sun protection: avoid 10 a.m.-4 p.m., reapply sunscreen, monthly skin self-exam.
critical_points.zh: 防曬：避開上午10點至下午4點、補擦防曬乳、每月自我檢查皮膚。

critical_points.en: Psoriasis: silvery-white scales; Koebner phenomenon (lesions at injury sites).
critical_points.zh: 乾癬：銀白鱗屑；Koebner現象（創傷處長出病灶）。

critical_points.en: Stevens-Johnson: stop the suspected drug immediately; mucous membrane and eye involvement.
critical_points.zh: 史蒂文斯-強生症候群：立即停用可疑藥物；黏膜與眼睛受累。

critical_points.en: Stage 2 pressure injury = partial-thickness dermal loss, not full-thickness.
critical_points.zh: 第2期壓力性損傷＝真皮部分皮層缺損，非全層。

mnemonics.en: Melanoma ABCDE: Asymmetry, Border irregular, Color varied, Diameter > 6 mm, Evolving.
mnemonics.zh: 黑色素瘤ABCDE：不對稱、邊界不規則、顏色不均、直徑>6 mm、持續變化。

mnemonics.en: Pressure injury stages: 1 intact red, 2 partial-thickness, 3 full-thickness fat, 4 muscle/bone exposed.
mnemonics.zh: 壓力性損傷：1期完整發紅、2期部分皮層、3期全層脂肪、4期暴露肌/骨。

stem.en: What is the nurse's first priority when teaching first aid for a snakebite to an extremity?
stem.zh: 教導肢體蛇咬急救時，護理師首要優先事項為何？

options.en: Keep the limb below heart level
Move the victim away from the snake and have him rest
options.zh: 將傷者移離蛇並使其休息

rationale.en: Safety first, then rest to slow venom spread, then remove constrictions and immobilize.
rationale.zh: 先確保安全並休息以減緩毒液擴散，再取下束縛物並固定。

stem.en: A client touched poison ivy 10 minutes ago and nothing is visible. What should the nurse advise?
stem.zh: 病人10分鐘前接觸毒藤，皮膚尚無異狀。護理師應建議？

options.en: Shower immediately, lathering and rinsing several times
options.zh: 立即淋浴，反覆起泡沫沖洗

options.en: Do nothing until a rash appears

rationale.en: Urushiol forms an invisible film; prompt washing removes it.
rationale.zh: Urushiol形成看不見的油膜；及早清洗可去除。

stem.en: Which nurses should NOT be assigned to a client with herpes zoster? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些護理師不應被指派照護帶狀疱疹病人？（複選）

rationale.en: Shingles virus can cause chickenpox in non-immune persons.
rationale.zh: 帶狀疱疹病毒可使無免疫者感染水痘。

stem.en: A client with frostbite of the hand arrives at the ED. Which action is correct?
stem.zh: 手部凍傷病人到急診。哪項處置正確？

options.en: Rewarm in 40-42 C water, handle gently

rationale.en: Rapid warm-water rewarming; no rubbing, dry heat or compression.
rationale.zh: 以溫水快速復溫；禁搓揉、乾熱或壓迫。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which finding best matches basal cell carcinoma? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些發現最符合基底細胞癌？（複選）

options.en: Highly metastatic to brain and lung

rationale.en: Basal cell metastasis is rare; melanoma is highly metastatic.
rationale.zh: 基底細胞癌很少轉移；黑色素瘤才高度轉移。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with psoriasis treated for 2 months: which finding shows improvement? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 乾癬病人治療2個月，哪些發現顯示改善？（複選）

rationale.en: Improvement is reduced plaques and scaling; striae and pulses are unrelated.
rationale.zh: 改善為斑塊與鱗屑減少；妊娠紋與脈搏無關。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client develops fever, mucosal erosions and blistering skin 10 days after starting a sulfonamide antibiotic. What is the nurse's priority?
stem.zh: 病人開始磺胺類抗生素10天後發燒、黏膜糜爛、皮膚起水泡。護理師首要處置？

options.en: Notify the provider and stop the suspected medication
options.zh: 通知醫師並停用可疑藥物

rationale.en: Suspect Stevens-Johnson syndrome; stopping the drug is the first step.
rationale.zh: 懷疑史蒂文斯-強生症候群；首先停藥。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which findings describe a stage 2 pressure injury?
stem.zh: 哪項描述第2期壓力性損傷？

options.en: Partial-thickness loss of dermis, shallow pink ulcer or blister
options.zh: 真皮部分皮層缺損、淺粉紅潰瘍或水泡

rationale.en: Stage 1 is intact, stage 3 full-thickness, stage 4 exposed deeper structures.
rationale.zh: 第1期完整、第3期全層、第4期暴露更深結構。
